item.description:
Piano Lunaire presents this portrait pop-up concert, showcasing the piano works of GRAMMY-nominated composer David T. Little on the eve of the Canadian premiere of his opera, "Dog Days". Pianists Adam Sherkin, Stephanie Chua and violinist Roan Ma present Little's complete piano works plus a piece for violin and electronics. The composer will be in attendance.
PROGRAMME:
Hang Together for solo piano (2022) Accumulation of Purpose (Six Studies for solo piano) (2017) Elegy (monsters are real) for solo piano (2016) Hellhound (2013) for violin and electronics
TICKETS: www.simpletix.com/e/pl-pop-up-the-piano-music-of-david-t-littl-tickets-297747 https://www.simpletix.com/e/pl-pop-up-the-piano-music-of-david-t-littl-tickets-297747

item.title: Seniors E-Connect — Wed Nov 18, 4:00 PM — Lillian H. Smith
item.description:
Are you 55+? Do you have a phone, tablet or computer you don't know how to use or want to learn to use better? Do you enjoy meeting new people? Seniors E-Connect will help you learn tech topics in a fun group setting, but with the one-on-one help of a teen volunteer under the guidance of library staff. Learn the basics of using computers, tablets and smartphones and popular websites and software. If you're a teen between the ages of 13-17 and would like to learn more about becoming a Seniors E-Connect volunteer, visit the Seniors E-Connect Volunteering page or contact the branch. **Please note that Seniors E-Connect at Lillian H Smith will not be running for the months of December and January 2026. We will resume in February 2027.

item.description:
Soul City Social Club (Toronto, Canada) Good day everyone,
Join me for the very first **Candlelight Fridays at The Pheasant**, an intimate evening of original music, storytelling and friendly company in a warm, cozy pub setting.
I'll be sharing a selection of songs I've written over the years, ranging from heartfelt folk and country ballads to soulful melodies, rock and playful satire. My songs are filled with characters searching for love, navigating life's ups and downs, questioning the world around them and sometimes simply laughing at its absurdities.
Along the way, I'll share a few personal stories about what inspired the songs and how they came to life.
So come grab a drink, enjoy some dinner, settle in by candlelight and see where the music takes us!
*We'll also be joined by members of my other social group, so there'll be plenty of friendly company to enjoy the evening with!*

About the Books: Disruption by Stella Leventoyannis Harvey Young Kitianna has always been curious about what life is like on the other side of the wall that divides her war-scarred country. When her actions draw the scrutiny of the authorities, Kitianna’s parents realize the only way to keep her from being forced into a re-education camp is to send her away. But while they may have secured their daughter’s safety, at least for now, the underground protest movement against the government is getting stronger, and the regime’s reaction has been to double down on draconian security measures.
